A Brisbane legend since 1890. The Normanby Hotel, an original pub of Brisbane, has stood in exactly the same place for over 130 years. Since opening, it’s been a legendary spot to catch up, unwind and create memories. As soon as you step inside this living legend, you feel its character and history. With soaring ceilings, wraparound balconies, a lively beer garden, and a bistro full of charm, it’s the ultimate spot to dine, drink and hang out. Whether it’s to watch live sports, have a meal with friends, enjoy an icy cold drink or celebrate a special occasion, The Normanby is where Brisbane comes together.
